title: A Carbon-Aware Quantum Computing Framework for LCA-Driven Sustainability in Quantum Cloud Services
abstract: arXiv:2609.24224v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantum computing's environmental footprint remains poorly understood relative to classical infrastructure, and as quantum computing moves toward cloud delivery, Quantum Cloud Service (QCS) providers lack actionable guidance beyond platform-level carbon-accounting frameworks. Objective: This study extends the carbon-aware quantum computing (CQC) framework from a platform-level to a service-level model that translates empirical life cycle assessment (LCA) findings of a superconducting quantum computer into guidance for QCS providers. Method: We modeled the CQC framework via service-level embodied-carbon allocation, load-independent and load-proportional operational decomposition, and a workload-resolved application offset on the basis of results acquired through a cradle-to-grave LCA of a superconducting quantum platform. Results: The five-year footprint is 583 t CO2e (GKP) and 10,570 t (surface-code), dominated by embodied carbon (77.3-8

translated_title: 面向量子云服务LCA驱动可持续性的碳感知量子计算框架
translated_abstract: 相对于经典基础设施而言，量子计算的环境足迹仍然鲜为人知。随着量子计算向云端交付模式发展，量子云服务（QCS）提供商除了平台级的碳核算框架外，缺乏可操作的指导。研究目标：本研究将碳感知量子计算（CQC）框架从平台级扩展至服务级模型，将超导量子计算机的实证生命周期评估（LCA）结果转化为面向QCS提供商的指导。方法：我们基于对超导量子平台进行从摇篮到坟墓（cradle-to-grave）LCA所获得的结果，通过服务级隐含碳分配、负载无关与负载成比例的运行分解，以及工作负载解析的应用抵消，对CQC框架进行建模。结果：五年碳足迹为583吨CO2e（GKP方案）和10,570吨（表面码方案），主要由隐含碳主导（占比77.3-8...
tldr: 本研究提出将碳感知量子计算框架从平台级扩展到服务级，把超导量子计算机的生命周期评估结果转化为量子云服务提供商可操作的可持续性指导，并量化了五年碳足迹（GKP为583吨CO2e，表面码为10,570吨）。
en_tdlr: This study extends the carbon-aware quantum computing framework from platform-level to service-level, translating empirical LCA findings of a superconducting quantum computer into actionable sustainability guidance for quantum cloud service providers, with quantified five-year footprints of 583 t CO2e (GKP) and 10,570 t (surface-code).
